hypotheses.justification: The statement never needs Finite K: LieModel K .PSL 2 2 f only needs [Group K], and W : Subgroup (MulAut K) needs nothing more. The proof never uses it. UC22.P22fin.isL2Ev_of_isL2 and UC22.P22y.isCyclic_outer_of_isL2Ev take only [Group X] (the finiteness comes from the field F inside IsL2Ev). r1f2_isCyclic_of_outer takes only [Group K]. Deleting it leaves the proof unchanged.

The proof only passes hW to r1f2_isCyclic_of_outer, which uses it solely to apply hcyc W hW. The hcyc supplied is `fun _ _ => inferInstance`, which ignores it, because Outer K is cyclic (from isCyclic_outer_of_isL2Ev) and every subgroup of a cyclic group is cyclic. So no 2-group assumption is needed. The statement stays true: hWi says W meets the inner automorphisms trivially, so W injects into Outer K, a cyclic group, and therefore W is cyclic. To delete hW, drop that argument from the private helper (or give it a different proof). The helper's own proof already shows W embeds into the quotient by `inner K`, so isCyclic_of_injective into the cyclic Outer K works directly. This is independent of removing [Finite K].
